name: Kin
description: Kin, is a Singaporean family daily tv series, about the complexities of life, love and family relationships.  Years have passed since Yoke and Ella had their lives turned upside-down when they returned to be with their rightful families after being swapped at birth. Years later, Yoke has seemingly embraced her role as a status-conscious, high-society Shelley, assuming a leadership role in the family business. Ella has accepted her fate as a member of the salt of the earth, working-class Loh family but struggles to make something of her life.  The Lohs, Shelleys, Hassans, and Balas have overcome personal loss, incarceration, as well as estrangement of their loved ones; yet lingering tensions remain. Mysteries continue to unfold as characters pursue their individual agendas, while emotional drama abounds as surprising twists are revealed that threaten the stability to which they have become accustomed..

videos.title: EP 1
videos.overview: Two former classmates, drink-stall operator Loh May Wan and wealthy socialite Jessica Shelley, cross paths again when their daughters Ah Yoke and Ella are involved in a car accident. Henceforth, their lives are inextricably entwined. Meanwhile, Deanna, mother of three and devoted wife to her very hapless husband Kenneth Bala, makes a startling life changing discovery that affects her best friend Ananya. At the Hassans, dutiful wife Rosnani struggles with her domineering mother-in-law Adina, who dotes on her ‘perfect’ son Zaryn

videos.title: EP 2
videos.overview: The complexities of the Shelley family unravel as everyone from ex-wives to step-siblings fret over Ella at the hospital. At the Balas, Kenneth‘s reliance on Deanna comes to light as he struggles to manage the household chores and their three children without her. For Rosnani, there is more than meets the eye about her marriage with Zaryn as she focuses on having a baby.

videos.title: EP 3
videos.overview: Jessica is determined to find out who borrowed money from the loan sharks. Kenneth gets worried when Deanna has to go back to the hospital again for a check-up. Ah Hock receives another online post from his father, much to May Wan’s displeasure.

videos.title: EP 4
videos.overview: Deanna continues dealing with her health issues and worries about Kenneth's inability to manage the household without her. Jessica tries to resolve the loan shark crisis and Louis springs a surprise.

videos.title: EP 5
videos.overview: Ananya and Kenneth clash over Deanna, and in the process, they begin to wonder if everything is fine with Deanna. Zaryn continues to keep Syirah’s pregnancy under wraps. Meanwhile, May Wan receives a surprise inheritance.

videos.title: EP 6
videos.overview: Deanna wrestles with the reality of her diagnosis as Ananya tries to be there for her. Syirah gets jealous when she learns that Zaryn’s relationship with Rosnani continues to be closer than she thought. At the Shelleys, James is determined to oust Jessica from the family.

videos.title: EP 7
videos.overview: Tired of Zaryn's inaction to leave Rosnani for her, Syirah uses her fetal ultrasound scan to draw him in. Having gathered all evidence on Ella's paternity, James confronts Jessica about her infidelity. Ananya's insistence that Deanna break the news of her brain cancer to Kenneth backfires.

videos.title: EP 8
videos.overview: Despite Ananya’s attempts to engage Deanna, Deanna continues to keep her distance. Zaryn manages to convince Syirah to give him more time to strategise his divorce with Rosnani. After coming across an old news article, Jessica starts to suspect who her real daughter might be.

videos.title: EP 9

videos.title: EP 10

videos.title: EP 11
